name: Arafura Internet Services
summary: Darwin, NT ISP trading as 'Arafura Connect'; dialup origins (c. 1999), now NBN + ADSL2 + business ethernet + hosting + VoIP + cloud; still active under NORTHERN TECHNOLOGY HOLDINGS PTY LTD (ACN 104 365 675).

events.details: Darwin NT dialup ISP; founding year predates the archive and is approximate.

Still active as a Darwin NT ISP trading as 'Arafura Connect' (NBN, ADSL2, business ethernet, hosting, VoIP, cloud); ARAFURA INTERNET SERVICES / ARAFURA CONNECT and related business names held by NORTHERN TECHNOLOGY HOLDINGS PTY LTD (ACN 104 365 675, ABN active from 6 Jan 2014), business names registered 5 Mar 2015; arafura.net.au now redirects to arafura.com.au.
